analysis_scope: static router function f(h); no hidden-state distribution or runtime traces

method.bias_geometry: rank correlations, exact pairwise bias-proximity association, top-PC variance projection, and five-nearest-neighbor smoothness
method.cluster_recurrence: adjusted Rand index over expert IDs for k=16 partitions
method.clustering: average-linkage agglomeration on exact cosine distance; exact silhouette for k=2,4,8,16,32
limitations: router vectors are analyzed without samples from P(h)
correction effects on selected experts depend on hidden-state logits
cluster partitions are descriptive and do not establish functional specialization
cluster ARI detects recurrence of identity-aligned expert memberships, not motifs preserved under an unknown expert permutation
method.pairwise_similarity: exact all-pairs cosine over normalized 7168-element router vectors
method.spectrum: exact eigendecomposition of the centered 896x896 cosine Gram matrix
